proposal.summary: redis-py before 4.5.3 can leave an async connection open after canceling a command and may send response data from one request to an unrelated client in an off-by-one manner.
proposal.cwe_quote: can send response data to the client of an unrelated request in an off-by-one manner.

A.quote: leaves a connection open after canceling an async Redis command at an inopportune time

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review and apply redis-py updates to 4.5.3 or later; if unable to update, audit async connection handling and avoid canceling commands in production until mitigations are in place. Reproduce the issue to determine scope of data leakage and affected deployments.

evidence_quotes.quote: leaves a connection open after canceling an async Redis command at an inopportune time, and can send response data to the client of an unrelated request in an off-by-one manner.
please see CVE-2023-28859 about addressing data leakage across AsyncIO connections in general.
